content:
When tvOS 27 launches later this month, Apple TV users will get a completely redesigned Podcasts app. The new version adopts Apple's latest video podcast streaming technology.

However, eagle-eyed users may notice that the upcoming software update removes a feature that some may miss after the update: support for subscribing to shows via URL.

Apple TV 4K's Podcasts gets a major update, loses a niche feature

As previously reported, Apple TV 4K will add support for HLS-based video podcast streaming in the Podcasts app with tvOS 27.

This feature was previously introduced in the Podcasts app for iPhone and iPad with iOS 26.4. The Mac also supports HLS video shows via macOS 27 Golden Gate.

However, tvOS 27.0 is missing a feature in the new version. Shows added via custom URLs, such as member-exclusive feeds for paid podcasts, can no longer be used in the Podcasts app on Apple TV 4K running tvOS 27.

This may well be an oversight, or it could be that Apple plans to add it back in the future.

The Apple Podcasts app on iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch, Apple Vision Pro, and Mac will still support custom feeds after the OS 27 update.

tvOS 27 is only compatible with the second- and third-generation Apple TV 4K. The first-generation Apple TV 4K only supports up to tvOS 26, which still supports custom URL feeds.
